caption: The drawing depicts a women's blouse shown from two perspectives: the front view is larger and positioned in the upper left, while the back view is smaller and located towards the lower right. The blouse is predominantly red with intricate geometric and floral patterns in gold and white. It features puffed sleeves that taper at the cuffs, a high standing collar, and a banded waist with triangular detailing at the hem. On the front, there is a button closure offset slightly to the right, bordered by a patterned trim. The back view reveals pleating along the upper section and the same patterned trim running vertically. The background is a plain off-white color, and the artist's name, "HARRY GROSSEN," is written in small letters under the back view of the blouse.
title: Shirtwaist
